005package org.wpilib.smartdashboard;
006
007import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
008
009/**
010 * Root Mechanism2d node.
011 *
012 * <p>A root is the anchor point of other nodes (such as ligaments).
013 *
014 * <p>Do not create objects of this class directly! Obtain instances from the {@link
015 * Mechanism2d#getRoot(String, double, double)} factory method.
016 *
017 * <p>Append other nodes by using {@link #append(MechanismObject2d)}.
018 */
019public final class MechanismRoot2d extends MechanismObject2d {
020  private final double[] m_location = new double[2];
021
022  /**
023   * Package-private constructor for roots.
024   *
025   * @param name name
026   * @param x x coordinate of root (provide only when constructing a root node)
027   * @param y y coordinate of root (provide only when constructing a root node)
028   */
029  MechanismRoot2d(String name, double x, double y) {
030    super(name);
031    m_location[0] = x;
032    m_location[1] = y;
033  }
034
035  /**
036   * Set the root's position.
037   *
038   * @param x new x coordinate
039   * @param y new y coordinate
040   */
041  public synchronized void setPosition(double x, double y) {
042    m_location[0] = x;
043    m_location[1] = y;
044  }
045
046  @Override
047  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
048    synchronized (this) {
049      table.log("position", m_location);
050      super.logTo(table);
051    }
052  }
053}
